errors.evidence: The description completely fails to mention the central aspect of the chart: that it is a comparison between two years, 2014 (inner ring) and 2021 (outer ring). This is explicitly stated in the chart's title.
The chart category is labeled "Wohnungswesen", not "Wohnungs- und Gebäudeservices".
The chart does not contain a category named "Gesundheitsversorgung". It does have a category for "Kliniken" (clinics), which is mentioned separately.

errors.text_span: der Restförderung von Unternehmen, der restlichen Förderung
errors.evidence: The chart does not contain categories with these labels. These appear to be incorrect interpretations or translations of other labels.
This is an incorrect translation/mapping of the category "Übrige", which means "Other" or "Remaining".
The chart clearly shows 14 distinct categories/segments, not ten.

errors.text_span: die Segmente sind nach der Größe der jeweiligen Anteil angeordnet
errors.evidence: The segments are not arranged by size. For example, the largest segment "Übrige" (31.1%) is adjacent to the small segment "Kultur" (2.2%).
The description fails to list several categories shown in the chart, including Kultur, Sport/Erholung, Abfallwirtschaft, Kombinierte Versorgung, and Übrige Versorgung.

errors.text_span: Zusätzlich ist das Segment „Kultur“ in einer deutlichen helleren Farbe gekennzeichnet.
errors.evidence: The segment for "Kultur" is dark blue, not a "distinctly lighter color". Several other segments are colored in lighter shades, making this statement factually incorrect.

errors.text_span: wobei das Segment „Übrige“ mit 31,1 % der größten ist.
errors.evidence: This statement is incomplete. It only provides the value for the inner ring (2014) and fails to mention the value for the outer ring (38.1% in 2021), which is also the largest in its respective year. This simplification misses the comparative nature of the data.
